evidence.title: Edged US ‘Tops Out’ Second Sustainable Data Center on Edged Chicago Campus
evidence.excerpt: Edged reports structural-frame completion for its second Aurora data center, a future 72 MW critical-capacity facility designed for AI training and inference.
